script.fullScript: Three college students revolutionized fast food, one fresh salad at a time. We cook from scratch, sourcing locally and transparently, to bring you the best. Indulge in our chef-crafted, plant-forward dishes that nourish both body and soul. From farm-to-table to ocean-friendly packaging, we're redefining the fast food experience. Join the movement and taste the difference at Sweetgreen.
